dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 11, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Mets Walk Off in Thrilling Fashion, Cardinals Fall 5-4**

The New York Mets pulled off a stunning walk-off victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, winning 5-4. Jared Young led the charge for the Mets with a two-home run performance, driving in two runs and going 2-for-4. Juan Soto also made his presence felt, hitting his 14th homer of the season. Christian Scott's strong outing was not enough for the Cardinals, who lost their fifth consecutive game. Meanwhile, Devin Williams earned the save for the Mets with a dominant one-inning performance.

**Tigers Crush Twins in Dominant Fashion, 11-0**

The Detroit Tigers handed the Minnesota Twins a 11-0 drubbing, with an impressive team effort on display. Colt Keith led the way with a two-hit performance, including a three-run homer. Wenceel Pérez also made his mark, hitting his seventh homer of the season. Keider Montero was the standout pitcher, tossing 6.1 scoreless innings to earn the win for the Tigers.

**Marlins Shut Down Diamondbacks, 2-0**

The Miami Marlins secured a shutout victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, winning 2-0. Tyler Phillips was the driving force behind the Marlins' win, tossing 5.0 scoreless innings with five strikeouts. Jakob Marsee contributed with a crucial RBI single in the game.
